---
title: "Text features"
---

Steps that turn free-text columns into numeric features: token counts, TF-IDF
weights, hashes, embeddings (the grouping follows
[Feature Engineering A–Z](https://feaz-book.com/)).

No mlfeatures steps fill this family, and none are planned soon. Today the task
lives at the recipe's boundary instead:

- **Pre-compute simple text features** with polars or pandas string
  expressions before the frame enters the recipe (length, word count, contains
  a pattern), or reach for the `StepMutate` escape hatch inside it.
- **Vectorize with scikit-learn** — run ``TfidfVectorizer`` or
  ``CountVectorizer`` in a ``ColumnTransformer`` branch alongside
  `RecipeTransformer` in the same ``Pipeline``, so the recipe handles the
  tabular columns and sklearn handles the text.

*Stub — content to come.*
